<string name="sr_direct_selection_auto_repeat_desc">Hold a movement or scroll key on the navigation keyboard to repeat it</string>

<string name="sr_spell_show_diacritics_info">When enabled, picking a letter in Letter Spell Mode opens a variant page so you can pick an accented form (á, ä, etc.). When disabled, only the base letter is entered and Spell Mode stays at a fixed two keystrokes per character.</string>

<string name="sr_spell_show_uncommon_diacritics_info">When enabled, less common variants (ā, ů, ǔ, etc.) are added to the variant page alongside common ones. Requires \"Show diacritics in Spell Mode\" to be on.</string>

<string name="sr_spell_viet_mode_info">Vietnamese-specific variants (ư, ầ, ằ, etc.) are independent from common / uncommon. Include adds them to the variant page sorted to the front; Only shows just Vietnamese-tagged variants (and hides everything else).</string>

<string name="sr_spell_turkish_azeri_override_info">When enabled, i uppercases to İ (dotted capital) and ı uppercases to I (plain), regardless of system locale. Useful when typing Turkish or Azerbaijani in a non-Turkish system locale.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_crash_report_prompt">When on (default), after JustType crashes, opening Settings offers to email a crash report. The report includes only the error and your device model — never anything you typed. Turn off to stop the prompt.</string>
<string name="sr_main_submit_feedback_description">Bundles recent debug logs into a file you can send via email or any sharing app — useful if you\'ve run into a problem.</string>
<string name="feedback_no_logs_available">No debug logs are available to share.</string>
<string name="feedback_crash_body">JustType crashed recently. This report contains only the error details and your device model — no text you typed. Thanks for helping us fix it!</string>

<string name="info_prompt_show_accented_keys">Only affects languages whose accented letters have their own keys (e.g. Spanish). When OFF, the keyboard shows only the base letters — accented words are typed with their base letters and chosen from the selection list.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_require_accented_keys">Available when accented characters are shown on keys. When OFF, a word typed without its accents still appears in the selection list, slightly lower — typing q-u-e also offers qué. Turn ON only if you always type accents exactly; the reward is a very small efficiency gain.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_tone_label_style">Languages like Vietnamese type each syllable’s tone as its own key press — the tone’s symbol is shown at the bottom of its key. Choose how those symbols are labeled: the bare tone marks, the digits used by the VNI typing method, or the letters used by Telex.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_word_selection">How the Select key steps through the word list. List-based: each press moves down the list one word. Page-based: after stepping past the first listed words, the next press shows the following six words on the letter keys — press a key to choose its word, press Select again for the next six, or Delete to go back.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_paged_listed_words">With Page-based Word Selection, how many words the Select key steps through one at a time before switching to pages of six on the letter keys. Set to 0 to show pages immediately on the first Select press.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_optimized_layout_source">Each language has its own Optimized letter arrangement. If you have memorized one language\u2019s arrangement, you can keep using it for every language you type in \u2014 word prediction still uses the language you selected. Match typing language switches the arrangement automatically.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_ds_auto_repeat">When ON, holding your finger on a movement or scroll key of the navigation keyboard automatically repeats that key at the Auto-Repeat Delay Time interval (below). This can be much faster than tapping the same key repeatedly, for example when moving the selection across several elements or scrolling through a long list. Keys that perform one-time actions (like Tap or Home) never repeat.</string>
<string name="info_prompt_ds_auto_repeat_delay">The number of seconds between each repeated key activation while your finger is held on a repeatable key of the navigation keyboard.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_mj_exit_delay">How long (in milliseconds) you must hold the mouse pushed UP to release the joystick and restore the cursor. A mouse-button press releases it immediately at any time. Increase if you find yourself accidentally exiting; decrease for a faster escape.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_mj_reengage_hysteresis">How long after a voluntary release (mouse button press or UP-hold exit) before the joystick will recapture the mouse on hover. Prevents the joystick from immediately grabbing the cursor back when you intended to use it. Set to 0 to recapture instantly.</string>

issue.message: The resource `R.string.info_prompt_joy_exit_zone` appears to be unused
issue.errorLine1: <string name="info_prompt_joy_exit_zone">The relative limit that defines the outer boundary for joystick deflection within the keyboard region. You can move the cursor out of the JustType keyboard into the region above (or below) and use your joystick to navigate your device. When you move upward (instead of to the right) until you reach the Exit Zone, the keyboard border will start to flash, and once the Exit Delay time elapses, the cursor will appear in the region above the keyboard. Decrease the size of the Exit Zone to reduce how far you need to move the joystick to leave the keyboard (or pause the joystick). Although this is probably less useful, you can also pause joystick activity in the keyboard by deflecting the joystick to the right (instead of upward) to exit into the Selection List region. IMPORTANT NOTE: You will also need to open HeadBoard and configure a switch to use with the joystick in order to click (or double-click, etc.) at the joystick cursor location.</string>

issue.message: The resource `R.string.info_prompt_joy_exit_pause_delay` appears to be unused
issue.errorLine1: <string name="info_prompt_joy_exit_pause_delay">The number of seconds that the joystick must remain in the Exit Zone (with the keyboard border flashing) in order to exit or pause. If the keyboard border starts flashing but you don\'t want to exit or pause, just move the joystick back toward the center to continue using the keyboard. Once the keyboard border has flashed for the Exit/Pause Keyboard Delay Time, JustType will either (a) exit the keyboard into the region above (when moving upward) or (b) pause the joystick and display \"Joystick Paused\" (moving to the right). Reverse the process, moving all the way to the left to resume typing (\"un-pause\"), or move down to make the cursor \"push against\" the top border of the keyboard to re-enter the keyboard. Increase the Exit/Pause Delay time (or the Exit Zone size) if pausing/exiting happens too easily.</string>

<string name="info_prompt_ss_select_triggers_scan">Inapowashwa, kubonyeza swichi kuwasha kitufe cha Select kunaanza kiotomatiki utafutaji wa maneno yaliyoonyeshwa katika Orodha ya Uchaguzi wa sasa. Kuwasha kipengele hiki kunamaanisha kwamba Kuchagua neno KILA WAKATI kutahitaji mifungo miwili tofauti ya swichi: moja kuwasha kitufe cha Select, na kisha mara ya pili Kuchagua neno linalotakiwa wakati linatafutwa katika Orodha ya Uchaguzi. Kwa watu wengi, hii itakuwa NA UFANISI MDOGO ZAIDI, lakini kipengele hiki kinaweza kuwa na thamani ya kuchunguza ikiwa: (a) Modi ya Kurudia Kiotomatiki si chaguo linaloweza kutumika kwako (katika kesi hiyo, kushikilia tu swichi imefungwa kwenye kitufe cha Select kunatimiza kitu kile kile lakini kwa ufanisi zaidi); (b) Kuchelewa kwa Hatua ya Utafutaji kunahitaji kuwa kirefu sana, kwa hivyo kuandika herufi za ziada za neno kufupisha Orodha ya Uchaguzi kunachukua muda; na (c) unaweza kuendelea kuangalia Orodha ya Uchaguzi inavyobadilika na kugundua wakati neno lako linapotokea (uwezekano chini katika orodha).</string>

<string name="info_prompt_ss_select_triggers_scan">Cuando está ACTIVADO, presionar el interruptor para activar la tecla Select inicia automáticamente un escaneo de las palabras mostradas en la Lista de Selección actual. Activar esta característica significa que Seleccionar una palabra SIEMPRE requerirá dos cierres de interruptor separados: uno para activar la tecla Select, y luego una segunda vez para Seleccionar la palabra deseada cuando sea escaneada en la Lista de Selección. Para la mayoría de las personas, esto será MENOS eficiente, pero esta característica puede valer la pena explorar si: (a) el Modo de Auto-Repetición no es una opción viable para usted (en ese caso, simplemente mantener el interruptor cerrado en la tecla Select logra lo mismo pero más eficientemente); (b) la Demora por Paso de Escaneo necesita ser bastante larga, así que escribir letras adicionales de una palabra para acortar la Lista de Selección lleva tiempo; y (c) puede mantener un ojo en la Lista de Selección mientras cambia y notar cuando aparece su palabra (potencialmente más abajo en la lista).</string>

<string name="info_prompt_ss_select_triggers_scan">When ON, pressing the switch to activate the Select key automatically starts a scan of the words shown in the current Selection List. Turning this feature ON means that Selecting a word will ALWAYS require two separate switch closures: once to activate the Select key, and then a second time to Select the desired word when it is scanned in the Selection list. For most people, this will be LESS efficient, but this feature may be worth exploring if: (a) Auto-Repeat Mode is not a viable option for you (in that case, simply holding the switch closed on the Select key achieves the same thing but more efficiently); (b) the Scan Step Delay needs to be rather long, so typing additional letters of a word to shorten the Selection List is time-consuming; and (c) you are able to keep an eye on the Selection List as it changes and notice when your word appears (potentially lower in the list).</string>
